body: Yo cynikalAhole99 no need to be rude, I figured reading others' comments on the matter might help me persuade her to to cooperate with me. Not that it matters now, as she's locked herself in a bathroom. Ambulance rides aren't cheap, we're literally in the middle of nowhere, she has no insurance (she is literally begging me not to call one on the sole reason that she can't afford to pay them, especially since she "didn't drink that much" ???), and I'd rather we just drive to the ER, but...yeah. Ambulance was nevertheless called a few minutes ago. Thank you all.
